QA-BOOT-001.meaning: App did not reach usable canvas state
QA-BOOT-001.next: Check module imports, CDN access, runtime exceptions, and secure-context requirements

QA-BOOT-002.next: Inspect network/module errors and dependency URL/version

QA-REN-001.next: Inspect renderer creation, container sizing, and resize path

QA-REN-002.meaning: Rendered frame appears blank or nearly uniform
QA-REN-002.next: Inspect camera, lighting, scene contents, renderer context, and NaN state

QA-REN-003.next: Check camera matrices, object transforms, WebGL context loss, and invalid values

QA-CAM-001.meaning: Horizontal orbit produced no visible change
QA-CAM-001.next: Check pointer routing, OrbitControls enable state, and canvas touch-action

QA-CAM-002.meaning: Vertical orbit produced no visible change
QA-CAM-002.next: Check pointer routing, polar limits, OrbitControls configuration, and gesture interception

QA-CAM-003.next: Check camera state accumulation and accidental reset/clamping

QA-CAM-004.meaning: Pinch zoom produced no visible change
QA-CAM-004.next: Check touch emulation, OrbitControls TWO mapping, and preventDefault conflicts

QA-UI-001.next: Inspect safe-area CSS, fixed positioning, overflow and responsive breakpoints

QA-UI-002.next: Check hit target, pointer-events, event handler, and z-index

QA-UI-003.meaning: Inspector overlaps or obscures required control
QA-UI-003.next: Inspect bounding boxes and contextual panel placement

QA-PHY-001.meaning: NaN or Infinity detected in physical state
QA-PHY-001.next: Replay failing seed; inspect integration timestep, mass floor, spring forces and divisions

QA-PHY-002.next: Inspect anchor reset path and drag/edit state

QA-PHY-004.next: Reduce timestep/substep error; inspect stiffness, damping and force sign

QA-PHY-005.meaning: Reset did not return finite stable state
QA-PHY-005.next: Inspect reset snapshot and velocity clearing

QA-AUD-001.next: Check secure context, path, processor registration and browser support

QA-AUD-002.next: Inspect graph message, hit routing, output connection, gain and analyser path

QA-AUD-003.meaning: Output clipped or exceeded safe peak
QA-AUD-003.next: Inspect excitation scale, graph gain, limiter/compressor and unstable physics

QA-AUD-004.next: Inspect DSP state for NaN/Infinity and unstable recursion

QA-AUD-005.next: Inspect damping, DC accumulation and feedback loops

QA-AUD-006.next: Inspect integrators, asymmetry and output high-pass requirement

QA-STATE-001.next: Canonicalize model and inspect omitted or lossy fields

QA-STATE-002.meaning: Reload did not restore expected persisted state
QA-STATE-002.next: Inspect localStorage keys, parse errors and startup ordering

QA-PERF-001.meaning: Frame rate below target under baseline scene
QA-PERF-001.next: Inspect draw calls, pixel ratio, geometry count and simulation substeps

QA-PERF-002.meaning: Renderer resource count grows after repeated reset
QA-PERF-002.next: Dispose geometries/materials/textures and inspect leaked scene objects

QA-REG-001.next: Compare current screenshot with approved reference and inspect changed CSS/camera/scene

QA-HARNESS-001.next: Fix harness before trusting any app result

QA-HARNESS-002.next: Fix harness sensitivity/threshold before trusting any app result

QA-REL-001.meaning: Required QA result missing or stale
QA-REL-001.next: Run required gate against current commit

QA-REL-002.meaning: One or more unresolved QA codes remain
QA-REL-002.next: Resolve errors, rerun focused diagnostics, then rerun full gate
